result.topic_en: Gauss defines the quaternion-like product of two quadruples (a,b,c,d) and (α,β,γ,δ) giving (A,B,C,D), and lists congruences between Gaussian-integer fractions modulo the sums of four squares m and μ, noting that the product is not commutative.
result.transcription:
Schreiben wir
$a\alpha - b\beta - c\gamma - d\delta = A$
$a\beta + b\alpha - c\delta + d\gamma = B$
$a\gamma + b\delta + c\alpha - d\beta = C$
$a\delta - b\gamma + c\beta + d\alpha = D$
$aa + bb + cc + dd = m$
$\alpha\alpha + \beta\beta + \gamma\gamma + \delta\delta = \mu$
so ist
$\frac{C+Di}{A+Bi} \equiv \frac{c+di}{a+bi} \pmod{\mu}$
$\frac{C-Di}{A+Bi} \equiv \frac{\gamma-\delta i}{\alpha+\beta i} \pmod{m}$
$\frac{B+Di}{A+Ci} \equiv \frac{\beta+\delta i}{\alpha+\gamma i} \pmod{m}$
$\frac{B-Di}{A+Ci} \equiv \frac{b-di}{a+ci} \pmod{\mu}$
$\frac{B+Ci}{A+Di} \equiv \frac{b+ci}{a+di} \pmod{\mu}$
$\frac{B-Ci}{A+Di} \equiv \frac{\beta-\gamma i}{\alpha+\delta i} \pmod{m}$
Wir bezeichnen allgemein die Combination $a, b, c, d$ durch
$(a,b,c,d)$ und schreiben
$(a,b,c,d)(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta) = (A,B,C,D)$
Es ist also $(a,b,c,d)(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta)$ nicht mit $(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta)(a,b,c,d)$
zu verwechseln

methods.what: Definition of a non-commutative (quaternion-type) product of quadruples, the four-square composition
methods.quote:
$a\alpha - b\beta - c\gamma - d\delta = A$
$a\beta + b\alpha - c\delta + d\gamma = B$
$a\gamma + b\delta + c\alpha - d\beta = C$
$a\delta - b\gamma + c\beta + d\alpha = D$
